models_evaluated: EASY (Encounter Appropriateness Score for You) logistic regression model

links.outcome: Whether providers distinguished true model recommendations from artificial (false) recommendations in pilot
links.effect: Providers agreed more with true than artificial recommendations (Cohen's κ = 0.45, P < 0.001); moderate discrimination; 201 pilot encounters; model increased appropriate telehealth visits.
links.quote: Providers were more likely to agree with true versus artificial recommendations (Cohen's κ = 0.45, P < 0.001), and the model increased the number of appropriate telehealth visits.

screen.reason: Empirical study evaluating pilot implementation of a predictive logistic regression model (EASY) presented to providers and patients to optimize scheduling of telehealth versus in-person rheumatology visits.
